title: Lookup within one machine round
statement: Let $k,n\in\mathbb{N}$, let $x$ be a finite binary input, let $c$ be a configuration of a $k$-tape machine with states indexed by $\{0,\ldots,n\}$, let $q$ be such a state, and let $\mathrm{tr}$ be a transition table assigning an action to each state, input symbol (or blank), and tuple of scanned work-tape symbols. Let $a$ be the action prescribed by this table at $q$ and the symbols scanned in $c$. There are binary words $b,t$ and a time $T$ such that the serialization of the entire transition table is $b$ followed by the serialization of $a$ followed by $t$, $q\le |b|$, and $T\le 5$ times the length of the serialized table plus $4$; moreover, the round machine runs from the lookup configuration with the table stored on its table tape, the output summary and unary encoding of $q$ on its summary tape, both tape heads at $0$, and output prefix unchanged, to the state-tail configuration after $T$ steps, with the stated round-window property at every earlier step.
hypotheses_covered: Configuration $c$ with $k$ work tapes and states in $\mathrm{Fin}(n+1)$
